lines.text: A pilot just crash-landed a stolen plane on a Manhattan street.
And he only did it to win a drunken ten-dollar bet.
In nineteen fifty-six, Tommy was drinking at a New York bar.
A patron claimed nobody could fly from New Jersey in fifteen minutes.
Tommy snuck into a flight field and hijacked a single-engine plane.
He flew completely in the pitch-dark without radio or lights.
Then, he touched down smoothly right outside the tavern door.
The stunned plane owner was so impressed he dropped all charges.
The judge only gave Tommy a small hundred-dollar fine.
Two years later, another patron refused to believe the story.
So Tommy stole another plane and landed on the exact same street.
Proving to every skeptic in New York why...
